final_claim: For p≥7 with p≡1(mod3), smooth genus-four curves C_a:y³=x⁶+ax³+1 (a²≠4) have Cartier operator diag(H_r,B,(a²−4)^mH_r,B), r=(p−1)/3=2m and B=binom(4m,2m)(a²−4)^m; the monic separable polynomial H_r=[t^r](t²+at+1)^r has r distinct smooth marked roots. At those and only those parameters the invariants are (p-rank,a-number)=(2,2), otherwise (4,0); the genus-one quotient remains ordinary and the Prym has complementary stated invariants.
